name: Agent Bus
description: Local SQLite event bus for agent-to-main notifications and targeted session wakeups.

taskRoutesEnabled.description: Enable HTTP task-control routes. Keep false unless a reviewed owner-only activation gate has passed.

specialistTaskWritesEnabled.description: Enable specialist claim/heartbeat/artifact/result HTTP writes. Requires separate review and must stay false for owner-only route activation.

ownerTaskRouteKey.description: Local owner/control-plane key required by x-agent-bus-owner-key for owner-only task mutations when task routes are enabled.
